bio.text: Bob Archuleta was elected to the California State Senate in November 2018 and represents the 30th Senate District, which covers portions of Los Angeles County and Orange County.

According to his Senate biography, he is a former mayor of Pico Rivera and was appointed by President Barack Obama in 2012 to the Board of Visitors to the United States Military Academy at West Point.
He is an Army combat veteran and former paratrooper with the 82nd Airborne Division, and he served with the Montebello Police Department.
